title: the landing's morning: the exhaust signature and the stick
context: Owner, 2026-11-07, after the first look at THE LANDING with a still of his 2D game's opening: "the beginning is not working as intended. 1) we want the 'exhaust signature' effect in full screen, a close up of the boosters firing, as in the stalheart landing fleet 2d mini game. 2) the space bar must be the booster, and some form of wasd + mouse to orient the rocket and try to smooth the landing." Spec docs/superpowers/specs/2026-11-07-landing-mini-game-design.md section 10 (the owner's morning), plan docs/superpowers/plans/2026-11-07-landing-stick.md (four tasks), branch landing-stick from 184ab17d, unpushed.
